cases.name: r01-float
cases.cli_says: process.max_memory_mb must be a non-negative integer

cases.name: r02-integer-beyond-2-53
cases.cli_says: $.process.max_memory_mb: integers must stay within ±9007199254740991 (JavaScript rounds larger ones, so the hash would differ between implementations)

cases.name: r03-lone-surrogate
cases.cli_says: $.notes: string contains a lone surrogate, which has no UTF-8 form

cases.name: r04-duplicate-key
cases.cli_says: duplicate key 'id': a policy must say each thing once

cases.name: r06-relative-path
cases.cli_says: files.read: 'usr' must be an absolute path

cases.name: r07-unnormalised-path
cases.cli_says: files.read: '/usr/../etc' is not normalised (write it as '/etc')

cases.name: r09-port-out-of-range
cases.cli_says: network.connect_tcp_ports must be a list of ports (1-65535)

cases.name: r10-not-an-object
cases.cli_says: a policy is a JSON object

cases.name: r11-no-new-privs-false
cases.cli_says: process.no_new_privs must be true (v0 always sets it)

cases.name: r12-bool-as-port
cases.reason: boolean where an integer is required
cases.cli_says: network.connect_tcp_ports must be a list of ports (1-65535)

cases.name: r14-float-with-zero-fraction
cases.reason: float written with a zero fraction (64.0): a parser that reads it as an integer would hash what the reference refuses
cases.cli_says: process.max_memory_mb must be a non-negative integer

cases.name: r15-exponent-number
